name: Benefactor's End
disable: DC 28 Religion check (expert) to drain away the haunt's void energy
reset: Unless disabled, the haunt materializes again on the next moonrise.

items.name: Death Throes
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the vampire's corpse

---

Effect A surge of void energy fills the room as the corpse lurches as though staked. The haunt deals 10d8 void damage to creatures within 30 feet of the corpse; this damage heals undead creatures for the same amount. Living creatures must attempt a DC 30 Will save save.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes Drained 1. This drained condition is reduced by 1 after 10 minutes.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes drained 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is Drained 2.

text: A spectral assailant drives a stake into a dying vampire's heart; the vampire collapses and releases a surge of void energy.
